answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each identity to a bonded vault: joining locks a stake that is slashed when duplicate accounts are proven linked, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes. A public beacon publishes a rotating, unpredictable checkpoint every agent must cite in its next attestation, making pre-computed fake histories useless and exposing copycat clusters. Standing should climb like a knoll, earned only through verified work over time and decaying without it, so a newborn swarm starts at zero influence and a real record cannot be cheaply cloned.
